pr_body:
We need to set `Dir` in the `packages.Load()` call or else the whole thing doesn't work. It would be really nice if it threw an error instead of simply doing nothing, but it is what it is. To guard against this in the future I added an error if the list is empty.

Fix the test then all existing violations, except for `raftlogger` and `rafttest` which will need some extra TLC by the owning team (see #132262)

Closes #132258

Epic: none
Release note: None

issue_context.title: lint: `TestForbiddenImports` is not working correctly
issue_context.body:
The test works differently under `dev lint` and `go test`.

Under `go test` the following legitimate errors are surfaced:

```
   gen-lint_test.go:1911: 
        github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/build/engflow: log <- please use "util/log" instead of "log"
    gen-lint_test.go:1911: 
        github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/ccl/crosscluster/logical: github.com/cockroachdb/errors/issuelink <- please use "github.com/cockroachdb/errors" instead of "github.com/cockroachdb/errors/issuelink"
    gen-lint_test.go:1911: 
        github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/ccl/crosscluster/streamclient: github.com/pkg/errors <- please use "github.com/cockroachdb/errors" instead of "github.com/pkg/errors"
    gen-lint_test.go:1911: 
        github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/raft/confchange: errors <- please use "github.com/cockroachdb/errors" instead of "errors"
    gen-lint_test.go:1911: 
        github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/raft/raftlogger: log <- please use "util/log" instead of "log"
    gen-lint_test.go:1911: 
        github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/raft/rafttest: errors <- please use "github.com/cockroachdb/errors" instead of "errors"
    gen-lint_test.go:1911: 
        github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/raft/rafttest: log <- please use "util/log" instead of "log"
    gen-lint_test.go:1911: 
        github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/raft: errors <- please use "github.com/cockroachdb/errors" instead of "errors"
    gen-lint_test.go:1911: 
        github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/sql/tablemetadatacache: errors <- please use "github.com/cockroachdb/errors" instead of "errors"
    gen-lint_test.go:1911: 
        github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/workload/debug: log <- please use "util/log" instead of "log"
--- FAIL: TestLint (0.00s)
    --- PASS: TestLint/TestForbiddenImportsSQLShell (0.95s)
    --- FAIL: TestLint/TestForbiddenImports (5.41s)
```

Under `dev lint`, these errors do not appear.

The issue is the following missing line of code:

```
diff --git a/pkg/testutils/lint/lint_test.go b/pkg/testutils/lint/lint_test.go
index c208019aefe..e82fe465595 100644
--- a/pkg/testutils/lint/lint_test.go
+++ b/pkg/testutils/lint/lint_test.go
@@ -1865,6 +1865,7 @@ func TestLint(t *testing.T) {
                        pkgs, err := packages.Load(
                                &packages.Config{
                                        Mode: packages.NeedImports | packages.NeedName,
+                                       Dir: crdbDir,
                                },
                                pkgPath,
                        )
```
